{
  "name": "step-chain",
  "displayName": "Step Chain",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "A variant of next-steps: tick several suggested next prompts, in the order you choose, and run them as a sequence, one step per turn. Stops on interruption or error.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Yannick (yanmwisa)",
    "url": "https://github.com/yanmwisa"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/yanmwisa/claude-code-plugins/tree/main/step-chain",
  "repository": "https://github.com/yanmwisa/claude-code-plugins",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "suggestions",
    "next-steps",
    "sequence",
    "prompt",
    "function-hooks",
    "ui"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "minAnswerChars": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Shortest answer to suggest after",
      "description": "Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 80
    },
    "suggestSkills": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Suggest skills and slash commands",
      "description": "Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.",
      "required": false,
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
